lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: You're awake. Good. Hollowmere doesn't have the food to feed dreamers.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: The mine ate our Foreman and eleven of his crew two weeks ago. Whatever took them is still down there.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: Go down. Come back. Keep breathing. That's the whole job for now, warden.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: Talk to the others before you descend. Gruff sharpens, Moss brews, and Pip will beg you for maps.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: So it's true. You put the Foreman down.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: He was a good man under the rust. Whatever wore him down there, it wasn't him anymore.

choices.text: He wasn't a man at all at the end.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: Then Hollowmere needs more than a warden. It needs a spear.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: Rest. Resupply. Then go deeper — the town's fate is down there with the rest of them.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: They're walking back up. Brannoc's crew, lanterns lit, smiling like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: That's not rescue, warden. That's the pit reaching for us.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: I'm sorry about your father. I knew him. He'd have gone down after them anyway.

choices.text: I'll cut them loose myself if I must.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: The deep shafts have opened wider since your last descent.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: Whatever you found below, you'll tell me before you act on it. Understood?

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: It's over, isn't it. One way or another.

lines.speaker: Mayor Hilde
lines.text: The town holds, warden. Keep it that way.
